svg.text: Every wire, hole to hole (row letter, column number)
top + rail 1 to a1 5 V into VBUS, pin 40
a3 to top - rail 3 pin 38 GND
i18 to bottom - rail 18 pin 18 GND to the bottom rail
i40 to bottom - rail 37 OLED GND
i41 to bottom + rail 36 OLED VCC, 3.3 V
top + rail 29 to top + rail 35 only if the rail is split
top - rail 29 to top - rail 35 only if the rail is split
bottom - rail 29 to bottom - rail 35 only if the rail is split
bottom + rail 29 to bottom + rail 35 only if the rail is split
i7 to h42 GP5 SCL, pin 7
j6 to g43 GP4 SDA, pin 6
i17 to h44 GP13 to K4, pin 17
j16 to g45 GP12 to K3, pin 16
i15 to f46 GP11 to K2, pin 15
j14 to f47 GP10 to K1, pin 14
